actual_hs_list: 130232 (guar gum / guar flour & powders, refined splits — derived from guar seed; matches Food Grade Guar Gum, Industrial Grade Guar Gum, Fast Hydrating Guar Gum, Guar Refined Splits)

130232 (Guar Meal / guar churi — by-product of guar gum splitting; if sold as animal-feed meal it is still classified under 1302.32 in Indian practice, but a feed-grade churi/korma line may be entered under 2302/2308 — cannot_verify without a customs line)
130190 (other natural gums/resins — NOT corroborated: no product on the site is a non-guar natural gum; likely a generic/legacy code)
product_summary: Official site neelkanthpolymers.com (contact harish@npguar.com) presents itself as 'Guar Gum Manufacturer, Refined Guar Splits, Tamarind Exporters Suppliers India'. Declared product range on the homepage: (1) Food Grade Guar Gum, (2) Industrial Grade Guar Gum, (3) Fast Hydrating Guar Gum, (4) Guar Refined Splits, (5) Guar Meal. Site also claims an 'Exclusive Unit for Food Grade Guar Gum Production' and 'one of the Largest Warehouse Facility'. The site title additionally mentions TAMARIND as an export line, but no tamarind product page or specification appears in the declared product range — a product line missing from the declaration (tamarind would fall under 0810.90 / 0813.40, not 1301/1302).
role_hint: manufacturer (site claims own production unit for food-grade guar gum and refined splits; no trader/intermediary wording found). Note: the site is a single-product-family B2B catalogue with an enquiry form and no published plant address, capacity figures or certifications text visible on the homepage — manufacturer status is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS mapping: declared 130232 is CORRECT and exact for the core line (guar gum powder/flour, refined splits, fast-hydrating guar gum) — 1302.32 covers mucilages and thickeners derived from guar seed. Declared 130190 ('other gums and resins') is NOT corroborated by any product on the site: every listed item is guar-based, so 130190 looks like a generic/legacy code with no matching product line — status cannot_verify / likely redundant. Guar Meal is a real declared product but its correct code depends on end use (feed-grade meal/churi vs. gum-grade splits) and cannot be verified without a customs line — заявлено, не подтверждено. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is only PARTIALLY right: industrial-grade guar gum is genuinely an oilfield fracturing/ drilling-fluid additive, so the oil & gas link is real, but the company is an agro-processing (guar seed) unit, not a petrochemical one — the label overstates the chemicals side and omits the agro-processing nature. Trader signs: none evident (no 'we are trading house', no third-party brands); however the site is a template-style catalogue with only an email and a mobile enquiry widget, no registered address, GSTIN or plant location published — so the manufacturer claim stays 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Missing from declaration: the tamarind export line named in the site title (would need 0810.90/0813.40 if actually traded). Per project rule 3, no HS mismatch is a rejection ground: company is retained, code set corrected to 130232 as the factual primary code, 130190 flagged as unsubstantiated. No customs/B-L line was available to me in this task, so no shipment corroboration is asserted either way.
